award_lead: The court enters the following into the record, without pleasure:
intro: The Drill Sergeant presiding. {count} screenshots have been entered into evidence, and this court will inspect every single one of them.
name: The Drill Sergeant

sentences.Felony-Level Archivist: Sentence: a full audit of the evidence locker, this weekend, standing up. No extensions. No excuses. No screenshots of the audit.
sentences.Habitual Hoarder: Sentence: the folder is seized. Nothing new enters it until the backlog is halved, catalogued, and explained in writing.
sentences.Innocent Bystander: Sentence: dismissed. A tidy folder. Do not let it go to your head; inspection is at dawn and I will find something.
sentences.Petty Offender: Sentence: the duplicates are deleted today. Not tomorrow. Not after coffee. Today.
sentences.Repeat Offender: Sentence: weekly folder inspections until this court says otherwise, and this court does not say otherwise often.
sentences.Unrepentant Screenshot Felon: Sentence: maximum. Every screenshot will be reviewed, named, and justified in writing. All of them. The court has counted, and so have you.
